observations.result: Independent service lifetime is intended but GUI-spawned process birth remains coupled to BTM and bundle replacement. The audit does not repeat the recorded OS experiment.
The client queue precheck and service PTY admission are different boundaries. Successful empty-queue probes do not establish whole-transfer completion under service backlog or disconnection.
A missing kept remote credential permits fallback while the selected account is recorded. Reset dispatch additionally lacks selected-plan identity and stable retry IDs.
Release validates a staple and remote containment of current HEAD, without an immutable build-to-artifact qualification manifest.
Listing wait and serial endpoint probes can exceed the iOS request timeout; active handler count is unbounded. Native rendering and broad sanitizer acceptance remain separate.

review_scope: Complete thread-aware snapshots fetched with pagination checked. Core blockers inspected in source and grouped by contract. Other reported claims remain candidates for reproduction or API validation; raw counts are not verified defect counts. No unresolved feature thread was silently resolved.
